newsitem.title: USA: USDA rolls out boll weevil loan program.
newsitem.headline: USDA rolls out boll weevil loan program.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department announced Friday terms of a proposed boll weevil eradication loan program that would spread start-up costs for producer groups in Texas, Mississippi and other states over several years.
In a notice published in the Federal Register, the Farm Service Agency said it would accept public comments on the proposal until July 15.
The USDA program is designed to help state non-profit groups eradicate the bollweevil. The loans cannot be made to individuals or small businesses.
USDA provides equipment, technical advice and cost-sharing of up to 30 percent of the program costs for cotton groups working to rid fields of the pest.

High initial costs of eradication programs have caused financial hardships for many producers, which are assessed fees to help pay for the programs, the agency said. The USDA said its change in terms was designed to spread initial start-up costs over several years.
